# About

Hi everyone! I am a second year MPH candidate at Columbia Mailman's School of Public Health. My long-term goal is to bridge the gaps in our healthcare system that leave underserved populations behind—through data-driven research, public health policy, and compassionate, community-centered care. 

My website will highlight my education, professional experiences, and show some plots I made using publically available restaurant inspection data in NYC.

## Interests
- Health equity in rural communities
- Understanding the Social Determinants of Health Into Quantiative Data
- Intersection of Public Health and Medicine
 -Epidemiological methods and data visualization
-Using public data to inform health policy
